title: 第526章 初祖的猜测 平行位面之说第525章 拜师三祖
slug: 多子多福家族帮我攻略极品仙子
lines: 初祖江启道死死盯着那截断指。
他伸出手，指尖逼出一滴大帝精血，落在断指之上。
双手结印，无净天机诀全力运转。
大殿上方，一条虚幻的时光长河若隐若现。
初祖的脸色以肉眼可见的速度变得苍白，他的双眼死死盯着时光长河中的某一个节点，试图看穿那片废墟的真面目。
片刻后，时光长河崩碎。
初祖闷哼一声，嘴角溢出鲜血。
“大哥！”
几位老祖齐声惊呼。
初祖摆了摆手，示意自己无碍。
他擦去嘴角的血迹，目光中透着前所未有的凝重。
“我算不透，那里的因果，被一股极其恐怖的力量彻底抹除了。”
初祖看向江渊，声音低沉。
“但结合你看到的‘江家’牌匾，以及觅月仙藏匿三身的手法，我推测，那里不是过去，也不是未来。”
“那是应该是另一个……帝仙大世界。”
另一个帝仙？
此言一出，众人皆惊。
“大哥，您的意思是……在咱们这方帝仙大世界之外，还存在着另一个一模一样的世界？”
三祖的眉头紧紧皱起，这个猜测，已经完全超出了他对混沌宇宙的认知。
“平行世界？”
江渊本能的想到了这个词，脱口而出道。
“平行世界……平行世界。”
初祖无意识的念叨着这个词，眼神愈发明亮。
“没错，就是这个！
渊儿的这个词形容的特别贴切！”
初祖的目光变得悠远，仿佛陷入了久远的回忆。
“在神话时代末期，老夫崛起之时，帝仙大世界也曾出现过一些……很奇怪的人。”
“他们仿佛能未卜先知，总能提前布局，拿出一些闻所未闻的功法、丹方，甚至还有一些……匪夷所思的经营之道，其想法之奇特，思路之清奇，完全不似我们这个时代该有的产物。”
“大哥，你说的该不会是那个想用‘灵石票号’一统诸天，想让所有帝族都给他打工的万宝道人吧？”
六祖江无晦一拍大腿，来了兴致，
“我记得那家伙，当年可是搅得天翻地覆，不少老牌势力都被他用灵石砸得晕头转向，差点就让他成功了。”
初祖缓缓点头，神情有些古怪：“正是他。”
江渊顿时来了兴趣，追问道：“详细说说。”
“那万宝道人，凭空出现，其来历无人知晓。”
六祖抢着说道，眉飞色舞地比划着，
“他当年拿出的那些东西，可把当时的老顽固们气得不轻，骂他是歪门邪道，不敬天材地宝，不尊古法传承。”
“就说炼丹吧，咱们炼丹，讲究的是心神合一，天人感应。
他倒好，搞出个什么‘流水线炼丹法’，将一炉丹药的炼制过程，拆分成上百个步骤，让不同的人负责，还说什么灵力要‘量化’，火候要‘标准化’。
当时炼出来的丹药，品质驳杂不堪，被当成了天大的笑话。”
“后来还成立了一个叫‘万宝阁’的势力，不争地盘，不抢资源，只做一件事——发行一种名为‘灵石票’的东西。”
“那玩意儿就是一张特殊的玉符，上面有他独特的道纹烙印，一张就能代表百万、千万，甚至上亿的灵石。
他说修士们带着成堆的灵石到处跑太麻烦，用他的灵石票，方便又安全，可以在诸天万界的任何一个万宝阁分号里，随时兑换成等额的灵石。
结果根本就没人认可。”
“那他最后是怎么死的？”
江渊听得心头一动。
content_en:
The first ancestor, Jiang Qidao, stared at the amputated finger.
He stretched out his hand, forced out a drop of the Emperor's essence and blood from his fingertips, and landed on the severed finger.
Forming seals with both hands, Wu Jing Tian Ji Jue is operating at full strength.
Above the main hall, an illusory river of time looms.
The first ancestor's face turned pale at a speed visible to the naked eye. His eyes were fixed on a certain node in the long river of time, trying to see through the true face of the ruins.
After a while, the long river of time collapsed.
The first ancestor groaned, and blood spilled from the corner of his mouth.
"Brother!"
Several ancestors exclaimed in unison.
The First Ancestor waved his hand to indicate that he was fine.
He wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, his eyes looking solemn as never before.
"I can't figure it out. The cause and effect there was completely wiped out by an extremely terrifying force."
The first ancestor looked at Jiang Yuan with a low voice.
"But combined with the 'Jiang Family' plaque you saw and Miyuexian's method of hiding the three bodies, I surmise that that place is neither the past nor the future."
"That should be another... the Great World of Emperor Immortal."
Another Emperor Immortal?
As soon as this statement came out, everyone was shocked.
"Brother, what do you mean...besides our Fang Dixian world, there is another world that is exactly the same?"
The Third Ancestor's brows furrowed tightly. This guess was completely beyond his understanding of the chaotic universe.
"Parallel world?"
Jiang Yuan instinctively thought of this word and blurted it out.
"Parallel world...parallel world."
The first ancestor muttered this word unconsciously, his eyes getting brighter.
"Yes, that's it!
Yuan'er's word describes it very aptly! "
The ancestor's eyes became distant, as if he was caught in a long memory.
"At the end of the Age of Mythology, when I was rising, some... very strange people also appeared in the Great World of Emperor Immortal."
"They seem to be able to predict things before they happen. They can always plan ahead and come up with some unheard-of techniques, elixirs, and even some...unbelievable business methods. Their ideas are so strange and their ideas are so clear that they are completely unlike the products of our era."
"Brother, are you talking about the Wanbao Taoist who wants to use the 'Lingshi Ticket Number' to unify the world and wants all the imperial clans to work for him?"
The Sixth Patriarch Jiang Wuhui patted his thigh and became interested.
"I remember that guy. He caused a huge stir back then. Many established forces were stunned by his use of spiritual stones, and he almost succeeded."
The first ancestor nodded slowly, with a strange look on his face: "It's him."
Jiang Yuan suddenly became interested and asked, "Tell me in detail."
"That Wanbao Taoist appeared out of thin air, and no one knows his origin."
The Sixth Patriarch rushed to say, gesticulating with joy,
"The things he took out back then made the old diehards at that time very angry. They scolded him for being a crooked person, disrespecting the treasures of nature, materials and earth, and disrespecting the inheritance of ancient laws."
"Let's talk about alchemy. When we make alchemy, what we pay attention to is the unity of the mind and the connection between heaven and man.
It would be better for him to come up with some kind of 'assembly line alchemy method', split the refining process of a batch of elixirs into hundreds of steps, put different people in charge, and said that spiritual power should be 'quantified' and the heat should be 'standardized'.
The elixirs produced at that time were of mixed quality and were regarded as a big joke. "
"Later, a force called 'Wanbao Pavilion' was established. They did not compete for territory or resources. They only did one thing - issuing something called 'Spiritual Stone Tickets'."
"That thing is a special jade talisman with his unique Dao pattern imprint on it. One piece can represent millions, tens of millions, or even hundreds of millions of spiritual stones.
He said that it was too troublesome for monks to carry piles of spiritual stones everywhere. Using his spiritual stone tickets was convenient and safe. It could be exchanged for equal amounts of spiritual stones at any Wanbao Pavilion branch in the world.
As a result, no one recognized it at all. "
"Then how did he die in the end?"
Jiang Yuan's heart moved when he heard this.
